deadline.value: Paid PhD positions are advertised as vacancies with their own deadlines
deadline.quote: Every year, LION has paid positions available for PhD candidates, that are filled on a merit basis.

supervisor.value: Apply to a specific advertised position; requirements are set with the thesis supervisor
supervisor.quote: Specific requirements of the PhD programme depend on the specialisation chosen and are determined in agreement with the supervisor of the thesis.

funding.value: All LION PhD projects are 4-year fully paid positions (usually a 1+3-year contract) with about 10% teaching
funding.quote: All of our PhD projects are 4-year fully paid positions, usually consisting of a 1-year+3-year contract.

entry_route.quote: An MSc degree is required for admission to the PhD programme.

notes: Self-funded entry possible with grants covering living costs and a bench fee.
